बॉलीवु़ड के गलियारों से आ गई है एकदम गरमा-गरम और चटपटी खबर! 🔥

प्रोड्यूसर दिल राजू ने बड़ा खुलासा करते हुए कंफर्म कर दिया है।
अक्षय कुमार स्टारर फिल्म 'Mauja Hi Mauja' अब फरवरी 2027 में थिएटर्स में आएगी।
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, इस कॉमेडी ड्रामा के ऑल-इंडिया डिस्ट्रीब्यूशन राइट्स 60 करोड़ रुपये में बिके हैं।
पहले इस फिल्म की रिलीज तारीख 4 दिसंबर तय थी और मेकर्स ने 27 नवंबर पर भी विचार किया था।
अनीस बज़मी के निर्देशन में बनी इस फिल्म में अक्षय कुमार के साथ विद्या बालन और राशी खन्ना भी नजर आएंगी।
यह फिल्म Sri Venkateswara Creations और Cape of Good Films के बैनर तले बनी है।
क्या आप अक्षय कुमार की इस कॉमेडी फिल्म का इंतजार कर रहे हैं? 🎬
कमेंट करके फटाफट बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Dil Raju CONFIRMS that Akshay Kumar-starrer Mauja Hi Mauja will be released in cinemas in February 2027
ctx.summary:
Bollywood Hungama has been at the forefront in giving news about Akshay Kumar's much-awaited upcoming film, Mauja Hi Mauja. In September, we broke the news that comedy drama will be released in India by PVR INOX Pictures Limited. We also reported that the all-India distribution rights of the film have been sold for a healthy sum of Rs. 60 crores. Earlier, Mauja Hi Mauja was scheduled to be released on December 4 and the makers also toyed with the idea to bring it out in cinemas on November 27. But now producer Dil Raju has confirmed that Mauja Hi Mauja will release in February next year. Dil Raju is the distributor of the grand Diwali release, Ramayana, in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. At the success meet of the Ranbir Kapoor-starrer in Hyderabad, Dil Raju said, “Since all of you are from the Telugu media, we tend to give a little less coverage to Bollywood, right? Right now, we have a film with Salman Khan that is in its final stages of completion. It will release in March, during Eid. Similarly, we have completed a film with Akshay Kumar, which will release in February. Today, in Bollywood, SVCC (Sri Venkateswara Creations) is a major production house making films with two big superstars.” The film with Salman Khan is named Monster. Bollywood Hungama has been at the forefront in giving news about Akshay Kumar's much-awaited upcoming film, Mauja Hi Mauja . In September, we broke the news that comedy drama will be released in India by PVR INOX Pictures Limited. We also reported that the all-India distribution rights of the film have been sold for a healthy sum of Rs. 60 crores. Earlier, Mauja Hi Mauja was scheduled to be released on December 4 and the makers also toyed with the idea to bring it out in cinemas on November 27. But now producer Dil Raju has confirmed that Mauja Hi Mauja will release in February next year.
Dil Raju is the distributor of the grand Diwali release, Ramayana , in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. At the success meet of the Ranbir Kapoor-starrer in Hyderabad, Dil Raju said, “Since all of you are from the Telugu media, we tend to give a little less coverage to Bollywood, right? Right now, we have a film with Salman Khan that is in its final stages of completion. It will release in March, during Eid. Similarly, we have completed a film with Akshay Kumar, which will release in February. Today, in Bollywood, SVCC (Sri Venkateswara Creations) is a major production house making films with two big superstars.” The film with Salman Khan is named Monster .

Besides Akshay Kumar, Mauja Hi Mauja also stars Vidya Balan and Raashii Khanna. Directed by Anees Bazmee, it is produced by Dil Raju under the banner of Sri Venkateswara Creations, along with Cape of Good Films.
Salman Khan will be seen in a rugged, macho avatar in Monster , as evident by his new look seen in public appearances and on season 20 of Bigg Boss. The superstar is joined in this film by Nayanthara and Muzammil Ibrahim. Directed by Vamshi Paidipally, Monster is presented by Dil Raju. It is a Sri Venkateswara Creations film, produced by Shirish and Kuldeep Rathore and co-produced by Rafi Kazi.
